authority: ROADMAP.md remains the plan of record. Review checkmarks are reading notes, not implementation or completion evidence.

tasks.title: Play the three existing C.19 entry routes
tasks.deliverable: Record Pixel observations for a door fight, getaway and Bear Path; preserve exact build and device.
tasks.doneWhen: Owner observations and physical-device errors/performance are recorded.
tasks.tests: Existing play-card and outing browser suites; physical play remains distinct.

tasks.title: Measure a tactical policy that reads actual threats
tasks.deliverable: Extend the current bot diagnostics before changing combat rules; compare all 15 fights with identical seeds.
tasks.doneWhen: Careful/focused/aggressive and getaway strategies have reproducible outcome and action-count evidence.
tasks.tests: fight-balance.mjs at 12 seeds, then 30; include Brace counts and traces.

tasks.title: Audit and polish one existing arena at a time
tasks.deliverable: Capture courtyard, yard, park, tram street and quay joins, exits and cover at the same cameras.
tasks.doneWhen: Before/after actual 3D captures identify the fixed fault; phone/landscape and device gates are recorded.
tasks.tests: Existing place/readability/context-recovery suites; no new production models.

tasks.doneWhen: Authored site, availability, choices and source approval status agree in a playable review route.
tasks.tests: Encounter gallery viewport and source-manifest checks.

tasks.title: Make an outing's persistent cost readable
tasks.deliverable: Show cash/loot, crew condition, missing/arrest and pressure in one compact return strip.
tasks.doneWhen: Exactly-once receipts and recovery routes agree with the visible consequence.
tasks.tests: Existing c19-outing and outing-browser plus the consequence review fixtures.

tasks.title: Replace the finale's single roll with a meaningful plan
tasks.deliverable: Review explicit crew assignment and container/van tradeoffs at the authored quay; retain watch/sell alternatives.
tasks.doneWhen: Owner chooses crew/route choice versus played fight, v4.97 income sources are preserved, separate stake/gate are tested across full runs before tuning and persistent outcomes are tested.
tasks.status: Proposed placeholder; owner design choice open
tasks.tests: Real engine fixture here verifies current gates and duplicate refusal, not the proposed design.

tasks.title: Integrate 30% travel/trade time behind full-run evidence
tasks.deliverable: Build a deterministic schedule-budget experiment and check all story beats/endings under time costs.
tasks.doneWhen: Ten-day runs remain reachable with the new costs and the owner verdict is recorded.
tasks.tests: Budget edge cases here; future full campaign bots with deadlines, wages and event time.

tasks.title: Prepare an Act I release candidate
tasks.deliverable: Run regressions, saved-fight recovery, ten-day runs, art approval and physical Pixel/iPad acceptance; record matching source/hub receipt.
tasks.doneWhen: Approved source bytes, CI, actual hub route and owner acceptance agree.
